extracted.intended_audience: Researchers, principal investigators, institutional representatives, and DOE laboratory staff applying to U.S. DOE Office of Science funding opportunities
extracted.subtask_short: DOE Office of Science FOA applications
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for preparing and submitting proposals in response to U.S. DOE Office of Science Funding Opportunity Announcements (FOAs), including eligibility, required documents, submission channels, and review information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical description of work to be funded
rubrics_metrics.description: A technical description of the type of work to be funded
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FOAs include a technical description defining the scope and technical objectives of funded projects; applicants must ensure their proposed work aligns with that technical description.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information about award type, size, number, and duration
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about the type, size, number, and duration of awards expected
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must match their proposed scope, budget, and timeline to the award types/sizes/duration described in the FOA (e.g., Phase I vs Phase II awards) and follow any FOA-specific limits or expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility criteria
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FOAs state which institution types or applicant categories are eligible (e.g., open to universities, small businesses, or 'Open only to DOE Laboratories'). Applicants must verify eligibility before submitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission instructions, required pre-applications and deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for submission of letters of intent (if required), preapplications or preproposals (if required), and applications or proposals; due dates and times
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow FOA-specific submission pathways (Grants.gov, PAMS, email), required pre-application or pre-proposal deadlines, and precise timestamps (e.g., 5:00 PM Eastern or 11:59 PM Eastern). Some FOAs require pre-applications or pre-proposals by an authorized institutional representative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorized institutional representative requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: A pre-proposal is required and must be submitted by an authorized institutional representative
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where stated, only submissions made by an authorized institutional representative (not individual PIs) are valid—confirm institutional authorization and submit through the required representative account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Merit review and review/selection information
rubrics_metrics.description: Review and selection information, including merit review criteria
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FOAs include how proposals will be reviewed and selected (e.g., formal merit review/peer review). Applicants should consult the FOA for the specific merit review criteria and tailor proposals to address those criteria explicitly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer review for DOE National Laboratory announcements
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals submitted by DOE National Laboratories in response to the below program announcements will be subjected to formal merit review (peer review).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When FOAs are targeted to DOE labs, submissions will undergo formal peer review—lab applicants should follow any lab-specific instructions and expect merit-review processes similar to external FOAs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of provided templates and sample agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: Phase I Application Template; Phase II Letter of Intent Template; Phase II Application Template; Sample OT and Project Agreements are available
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should use the FOA-provided application and LOI templates and review sample Other Transaction (OT) and project agreements to ensure required administrative and contractual content are included and compliant with FOA terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of FAQs and informational webinars
rubrics_metrics.description: Frequently Asked Questions is provided; Informational Webinars (Slides | Video)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FOAs often provide FAQs and recorded/slide webinars—applicants should consult these resources for clarifications, examples, and answers to common questions prior to submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency points of contact
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FOAs list agency points of contact for questions; applicants should use listed contacts for FOA-specific clarifications and follow any contact procedures described in the announcement.
